title: Acceptance by time
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine with a binary input alphabet, let $x$ be a finite binary string, and let $t\in\mathbb{N}$. The acceptance indicator is true exactly when there is some time $s<t$ at which the machine's snapshot on input $x$ emits the bit true; otherwise it is false.
hypotheses_covered: A finite Turing machine with binary input alphabet
